# Design writing format

<!-- Generated by kition-sdk tools/writing-format.mjs from the Design engine 0.1.0 and agent/guide.md. Regenerate it; do not edit it by hand. -->

What a model or a script writes to make or change a Design document: the run syntax, every
command and its parameters, the value lists and the defaults the engine states, and worked examples.
It is made from the command catalogue of the Design engine 0.1.0. Read
[`agent/guide.md`](../agent/guide.md) first: it says how to address things, the workflow, and the
pitfalls.

## Syntax

Changes are steps of `design_run`; each step is one command with its parameters as JSON:

```json
design_run { "path": "<file>", "steps": [{ "command": "<command id>", "params": { … } }] }
```

A run is one step in the document's history. `design_commands` finds commands by words; the
lists below are the whole catalogue. A parameter marked required must be given; a parameter left out
takes the engine's default (listed where the engine states one). Commands marked (reads) answer
without changing the document.

## Defaults

No schema states a default; the parameter descriptions name the defaults that exist.

## Commands

512 commands, by menu.

### File

- `file.import` (writes): Imports a file (SVG, image, .fig, .sketch or REST JSON) into the design at x, y; SVG becomes an editable frame of shapes and text.
  - `center` boolean
  - `data` string
  - `name` string, with data: the file's name
  - `path` file
  - `variables` object or string
  - `x` number
  - `y` number
- `file.placeImage` (writes): Places an image from a path or base64 data as a new image layer at x, y.
  - `data` string
  - `height` number
  - `mode` string, one of `fill` | `fit` | `crop` | `tile`
  - `name` string, the image's name
  - `width` number
  - `x` number
  - `y` number
- `file.saveVersion` (reads): Opens the version history's save form: the editor saves the version with the host, which keeps saved versions (never the design or its file). No parameters.
- `file.versionHistory` (reads): Opens the version history panel; the host keeps the saved versions. No parameters.
- `file.export` (reads): Exports layers (default the selection, else the page) as PNG, JPEG, SVG, PDF, WebP, Android Vector Drawable or the whole .fig, at a scale with print options; answers the data.
  - `bleed` number or string
  - `bleedMarks` boolean
  - `cmyk` boolean
  - `cropMarks` boolean
  - `format` string, one of `png` | `jpg` | `svg` | `pdf` | `webp` | `xml` | `fig`
  - `ids` array, default selection, else the page
  - `scale` number
  - `svgIdAttribute` boolean
  - `vdCompat` boolean
- `file.exportFramesPdf` (reads): Exports every top-level frame of a page, in reading order, as one PDF with optional bleed, marks and CMYK.
  - `bleed` number or string
  - `bleedMarks` boolean
  - `cmyk` boolean
  - `cropMarks` boolean
  - `page` integer, page id, default the current page
- `file.exportSvg` (reads): Exports the selected or given layers as SVG markup or to a file.
  - `ids` array
- `file.rename` (writes): Renames the document file.
  - `name` string
- `file.colorProfile` (writes): Sets the file's colour profile (sRGB or Display P3), converting colour values or reinterpreting them; without a profile answers the current one.
  - `convert` boolean
  - `profile` string, one of `srgb` | `displayP3`

### Edit

- `edit.undo` (writes): Undoes the last step in a scope (the person's or the agent's; default the caller's), leaving the other scope's later steps in place.
  - `scope` string, one of `person` | `agent`
- `edit.redo` (writes): Redoes the last undone step in a scope (the person's or the agent's; default the caller's).
  - `scope` string, one of `person` | `agent`
- `edit.cut` (writes): Removes the selected or given layers and puts them on the clipboard.
  - `ids` array
- `edit.copy` (reads): Copies the selected or given layers to the clipboard without changing the design.
  - `ids` array
- `edit.paste` (writes): Pastes the clipboard into a parent (default the current page or frame) at x, y; a copied main component pastes as an instance.
  - `parent` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `x` number
  - `y` number, page coordinates of the pasted top-left
- `edit.pasteOver` (writes): Pastes the clipboard on top of the selection, at the same position. No parameters.
- `edit.pasteReplace` (writes): Replaces the selected or given layers with the clipboard's content, in their places.
  - `ids` array
- `edit.duplicate` (writes): Duplicates the selected or given layers, offset by dx, dy (or repeating the last duplicate's offset); answers the copies.
  - `dx` number
  - `dy` number, page offset; default: the offset of the last duplicate when ids are its copies, still selected; else top-level frames to the right with a 100 gap, everything else in place
  - `ids` array
- `edit.delete` (writes): Deletes the selected or given layers.
  - `ids` array
- `edit.findReplace` (writes): Finds text in text layers (or layer names) and replaces it, selecting the matches by default; answers the count.
  - `find` string
  - `layerNames` boolean
  - `replace` string
  - `select` boolean
- `edit.copyProperties` (reads): Copies a layer's fills, strokes, effects and text style so edit.pasteProperties can apply them.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
- `edit.pasteProperties` (writes): Applies the copied properties (fills, strokes, effects, text style) to the selected or given layers.
  - `ids` array
- `edit.pickColor` (reads): Picks the colour under the eyedropper and optionally applies it to the selection.
  - `apply` boolean
- `edit.setDefaultProperties` (reads): Makes a layer's properties the defaults for new layers of its kind.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
- `select.all` (reads): Selects every layer on the current page (or in the current frame). No parameters.
- `select.matching` (reads): Selects the layers that match the selected one in kind and properties. No parameters.
- `select.none` (reads): Clears the selection, deselecting every layer. No parameters.
- `select.inverse` (reads): Selects the layers that aren't selected and deselects the others. No parameters.

### Edit > Select all with same

- `select.sameFill` (reads): Selects every layer with the same fill as the selected layer. No parameters.
- `select.sameStroke` (reads): Selects every layer with the same stroke as the selected layer. No parameters.
- `select.sameEffect` (reads): Selects every layer with the same effects as the selected layer. No parameters.
- `select.sameText` (reads): Selects every text layer with the same text properties as the selected one. No parameters.
- `select.sameFont` (reads): Selects every text layer using the same font as the selected one. No parameters.
- `select.sameInstance` (reads): Selects every instance of the same component as the selected instance. No parameters.
- `select.sameProperties` (reads): Selects every layer with the same properties as the selected layer. No parameters.

### View

- `view.pixelGrid` (reads): Shows, hides or toggles the pixel grid; view state only.
  - `on` boolean
- `view.layoutGrids` (reads): Shows, hides or toggles frames' layout grids; view state only.
  - `on` boolean
- `view.rulers` (reads): Shows, hides or toggles the rulers; view state only.
  - `on` boolean
- `view.slices` (reads): Shows, hides or toggles slices; view state only.
  - `on` boolean
- `view.comments` (reads): Shows, hides or toggles comment pins; view state only.
  - `on` boolean
- `view.pixelPreview` (reads): Turns pixel preview on, off or toggles it, at 1× or 2× rendered pixels.
  - `on` boolean
  - `scale` number, 1|2: rendered pixels per page pixel; turns it on
- `view.maskOutlines` (reads): Shows, hides or toggles mask outlines; view state only.
  - `on` boolean
- `view.frameOutlines` (reads): Shows, hides or toggles frame outlines; view state only.
  - `on` boolean
- `view.proofSrgb` (reads): Turns sRGB soft-proofing of a Display P3 file on, off or toggles it.
  - `on` boolean
- `view.prevFrame` (reads): Zooms the view to the previous top-level frame. No parameters.
- `view.nextFrame` (reads): Zooms the view to the next top-level frame. No parameters.
- `view.prevPage` (reads): Switches to the previous page of the file. No parameters.
- `view.nextPage` (reads): Switches to the next page of the file. No parameters.

### View > Outlines

- `view.outlines` (reads): Turns outline mode on, off or toggles it; view state only.
  - `on` boolean
- `view.outlinesSelection` (reads): Turns outline mode for the selected layers only on, off or toggles it.
  - `on` boolean
- `view.outlinesHiddenLayers` (reads): Sets whether outline mode also outlines hidden layers.
  - `on` boolean
- `view.outlinesObjectBounds` (reads): Sets whether outline mode also draws each layer's bounding box.
  - `on` boolean

### Object

- `object.frameSelection` (writes): Wraps the selected or given layers in a new frame, optionally named.
  - `ids` array
  - `name` string
- `object.group` (writes): Groups the selected or given layers, optionally naming the group.
  - `ids` array
  - `name` string
- `object.ungroup` (writes): Ungroups the selected or given groups, keeping their children in place.
  - `ids` array
- `object.removeFrame` (writes): Removes the selected frames, keeping their children in place.
  - `ids` array
- `object.resizeToFit` (writes): Resizes frames, sections and components to fit their contents without moving the contents.
  - `ids` array
- `layout.add` (writes): Adds auto layout (horizontal, vertical or grid) to the selected or given frames, or wraps other layers in an auto-layout frame.
  - `direction` string, one of `horizontal` | `vertical` | `grid`
  - `ids` array
- `layout.remove` (writes): Removes auto layout from the selected or given frames, keeping their children where they are.
  - `ids` array
- `layout.suggest` (writes): Adds the auto layout that best fits the current arrangement of the selected layers.
  - `direction` string, one of `horizontal` | `vertical` | `grid`, default: what fits the arrangement
  - `ids` array
- `component.create` (writes): Makes the selected frame or group a component, or wraps several layers in one.
  - `ids` array
- `component.createMultiple` (writes): Makes each selected layer its own component.
  - `ids` array
- `component.combineVariants` (writes): Combines main components into a component set of variants.
  - `ids` array, main components; none already a variant, a library copy or inside an instance
- `component.resetInstance` (writes): Resets every override of the selected instances back to their main component.
  - `ids` array
- `component.detach` (writes): Detaches the selected instances from their main component, turning them into frames.
  - `ids` array
- `component.goToMain` (reads): Selects and shows the main component of an instance.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
- `component.pushChanges` (writes): Pushes an instance's overrides into its main component, updating every instance.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
- `component.restoreMain` (writes): Restores a deleted main component from one of its instances, in that instance's place.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
- `object.mask` (writes): Uses the bottom selected layer as a mask for the layers above it in a group.
  - `ids` array
- `object.releaseMask` (writes): Releases a mask so the layers above it are no longer clipped.
  - `ids` array
- `object.setThumbnail` (writes): Sets a frame as the file's thumbnail.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
- `arrange.front` (writes): Brings the selected or given layers to the front of their parent.
  - `ids` array
- `arrange.forward` (writes): Brings the selected or given layers one step forward.
  - `ids` array
- `arrange.backward` (writes): Sends the selected or given layers one step backward.
  - `ids` array
- `arrange.back` (writes): Sends the selected or given layers to the back of their parent.
  - `ids` array
- `object.flipH` (writes): Flips the selected or given layers (or selected vector points) horizontally.
  - `ids` array
- `object.flipV` (writes): Flips the selected or given layers (or selected vector points) vertically.
  - `ids` array
- `object.rotate180` (writes): Rotates the selected or given layers (or selected vector points) by 180 degrees.
  - `ids` array
- `object.rotateLeft` (writes): Rotates the selected or given layers (or selected vector points) 90 degrees counter-clockwise.
  - `ids` array
- `object.rotateRight` (writes): Rotates the selected or given layers (or selected vector points) 90 degrees clockwise.
  - `ids` array
- `vector.flatten` (writes): Flattens the selected or given layers into a single vector layer.
  - `ids` array
- `vector.outlineStroke` (writes): Converts the strokes of the selected or given layers into filled outlines.
  - `ids` array
- `object.rasterize` (writes): Replaces the selected or given layers with an image of them at a scale (default 2).
  - `ids` array
  - `scale` number, default 2
- `object.toggleVisible` (writes): Shows, hides or toggles the visibility of the selected or given layers.
  - `ids` array
  - `visible` boolean
- `object.toggleLock` (writes): Locks, unlocks or toggles the lock of the selected or given layers.
  - `ids` array
  - `locked` boolean
- `object.hideOthers` (writes): Hides every layer on the page except the selected ones. No parameters.
- `layers.collapseAll` (reads): Collapses every row in the layers panel; the design is unchanged. No parameters.
- `object.removeFill` (writes): Removes every fill from the selected or given layers.
  - `ids` array
- `object.removeStroke` (writes): Removes every stroke from the selected or given layers.
  - `ids` array
- `object.swapFillStroke` (writes): Swaps the fills and strokes of the selected or given layers.
  - `ids` array
- `object.rename` (writes): Renames the selected or given layers (without a name, starts inline renaming in the layers panel).
  - `ids` array
  - `name` string
- `object.batchRename` (writes): Renames several layers at once by find and replace (optionally regex) or a pattern with numbering codes.
  - `find` string
  - `ids` array
  - `name` string, pattern for the whole name
  - `regex` boolean
  - `replace` string
  - `start` number, where $n starts and $N stops; default 1
- `object.moveToPage` (writes): Moves the selected or given layers to another page.
  - `ids` array
  - `page` integer

### Object > Boolean groups

- `bool.union` (writes): Sets union as the boolean operation of the selected operands or group, or wraps layers in a union boolean group.
  - `ids` array
- `bool.subtract` (writes): Sets subtract as the boolean operation of the selected operands or group, or wraps layers in a subtract boolean group.
  - `ids` array
- `bool.intersect` (writes): Sets intersect as the boolean operation of the selected operands or group, or wraps layers in an intersect boolean group.
  - `ids` array
- `bool.exclude` (writes): Sets exclude as the boolean operation of the selected operands or group, or wraps layers in an exclude boolean group.
  - `ids` array
- `bool.flatten` (writes): Flattens boolean groups into plain vector layers of their result.
  - `ids` array

### Object > Select layer

- `select.children` (reads): Selects the children of the selected layers. No parameters.
- `select.parent` (reads): Selects the parent of the selected layers. No parameters.
- `select.next` (reads): Selects the next sibling of the selected layer. No parameters.
- `select.previous` (reads): Selects the previous sibling of the selected layer. No parameters.

### Text

- `text.bold` (writes): Toggles bold on the selected or given text layers (or the selected text range).
  - `ids` array
- `text.italic` (writes): Toggles italic on the selected or given text layers (or the selected text range).
  - `ids` array
- `text.underline` (writes): Toggles underline on the selected or given text layers (or the selected text range).
  - `ids` array
- `text.strikethrough` (writes): Toggles strikethrough on the selected or given text layers (or the selected text range).
  - `ids` array
- `text.link` (writes): Makes the selected or given text (or text range) a hyperlink to url.
  - `ids` array
  - `url` string
- `text.bulletList` (writes): Turns the selected or given text's paragraphs into a bulleted list (or back to plain text).
  - `ids` array
- `text.numberList` (writes): Turns the selected or given text's paragraphs into a numbered list (or back to plain text).
  - `ids` array
- `text.missingFonts` (reads): Answers the font families the document uses that aren't installed, with the layers that use them. No parameters.

### Text > Alignment

- `text.alignLeft` (writes): Aligns the text of the selected or given text layers to the left.
  - `ids` array
- `text.alignCenter` (writes): Centres the text of the selected or given text layers.
  - `ids` array
- `text.alignRight` (writes): Aligns the text of the selected or given text layers to the right.
  - `ids` array
- `text.alignJustify` (writes): Justifies the text of the selected or given text layers.
  - `ids` array

### Text > Adjust

- `text.sizeUp` (writes): Increases the font size of the selected or given text layers by one step.
  - `ids` array
- `text.sizeDown` (writes): Decreases the font size of the selected or given text layers by one step.
  - `ids` array
- `text.weightUp` (writes): Moves the selected or given text to the next heavier font weight available.
  - `ids` array
- `text.weightDown` (writes): Moves the selected or given text to the next lighter font weight available.
  - `ids` array
- `text.lineHeightUp` (writes): Increases the line height of the selected or given text layers by one step.
  - `ids` array
- `text.lineHeightDown` (writes): Decreases the line height of the selected or given text layers by one step.
  - `ids` array
- `text.trackingUp` (writes): Increases the letter spacing of the selected or given text layers by one step.
  - `ids` array
- `text.trackingDown` (writes): Decreases the letter spacing of the selected or given text layers by one step.
  - `ids` array

### Text > Case

- `text.caseOriginal` (writes): Sets the selected or given text back to its original case (no case transform).
  - `ids` array
- `text.caseUpper` (writes): Displays the selected or given text in uppercase.
  - `ids` array
- `text.caseLower` (writes): Displays the selected or given text in lowercase.
  - `ids` array
- `text.caseTitle` (writes): Displays the selected or given text in title case.
  - `ids` array

### Arrange

- `align.left` (writes): Aligns the selected or given layers to their left edge (or a single layer to its parent).
  - `ids` array
- `align.hcenter` (writes): Aligns the selected or given layers on their horizontal centres.
  - `ids` array
- `align.right` (writes): Aligns the selected or given layers to their right edge.
  - `ids` array
- `align.top` (writes): Aligns the selected or given layers to their top edge.
  - `ids` array
- `align.vcenter` (writes): Aligns the selected or given layers on their vertical centres.
  - `ids` array
- `align.bottom` (writes): Aligns the selected or given layers to their bottom edge.
  - `ids` array
- `distribute.horizontal` (writes): Spaces the selected or given layers evenly horizontally, or by a fixed spacing.
  - `ids` array
  - `spacing` number
- `distribute.vertical` (writes): Spaces the selected or given layers evenly vertically, or by a fixed spacing.
  - `ids` array
  - `spacing` number
- `arrange.tidy` (writes): Tidies the selected layers into an evenly spaced grid, or by a fixed spacing.
  - `ids` array
  - `spacing` number
- `arrange.packH` (writes): Packs the selected layers side by side horizontally with no gaps.
  - `ids` array
- `arrange.packV` (writes): Packs the selected layers one above another vertically with no gaps.
  - `ids` array
- `arrange.roundToPixels` (writes): Rounds the position and size of the selected or given layers to whole pixels.
  - `ids` array

### Vector

- `vector.join` (writes): Joins the selected vector layers' open paths (or the selected points in vector edit mode).
  - `ids` array
- `vector.smoothJoin` (writes): Joins the selected open paths or points with a smooth curve.
  - `ids` array
- `vector.deleteHeal` (writes): Deletes the selected vector points and heals the path across the gap.
  - `vertices` integer[]
- `vector.simplify` (writes): Reduces the points of the selected or given vector layers within a tolerance.
  - `ids` array
  - `tolerance` number
- `vector.reverse` (writes): Reverses the path direction of the selected or given vector layers.
  - `ids` array
- `vector.offset` (writes): Offsets the paths of the selected or given vector layers outward (or inward for negative offset).
  - `ids` array
  - `offset` number

### Preferences

- `view.snapGeometry` (reads): Turns snapping to geometry on, off or toggles it.
  - `on` boolean
- `view.snapObjects` (reads): Turns snapping to objects on, off or toggles it.
  - `on` boolean
- `view.snapPixel` (reads): Turns snapping to the pixel grid on, off or toggles it.
  - `on` boolean
- `pref.keepTool` (reads): Sets whether a drawing tool stays selected after use.
  - `on` boolean
- `pref.highlightHover` (reads): Sets whether layers highlight on hover.
  - `on` boolean
- `pref.renameDuplicates` (reads): Sets whether duplicated layers get numbered names.
  - `on` boolean
- `pref.showDimensions` (reads): Sets whether the canvas shows dimensions on selected objects.
  - `on` boolean
- `pref.numberKeysOpacity` (reads): Sets whether number keys set the selection's opacity.
  - `on` boolean
- `pref.nudge` (reads): Sets the small and big nudge amounts used by transform.nudge.
  - `big` number
  - `small` number

### Libraries

- `component.hideWhenPublishing` (writes): Keeps components (or sets) out of the library this file publishes, or toggles that.
  - `ids` array, components, sets or layers in them; default the selection
  - `on` boolean

### (no menu)

- `tool.move` (reads): Chooses the Move tool in the editor; the design is unchanged. No parameters.
- `tool.scale` (reads): Chooses the Scale tool in the editor; the design is unchanged. No parameters.
- `tool.hand` (reads): Chooses the Hand tool in the editor; the design is unchanged. No parameters.
- `tool.frame` (reads): Chooses the Frame tool in the editor; use frame.create to make a frame directly. No parameters.
- `tool.section` (reads): Chooses the Section tool in the editor; use node.create to make a section directly. No parameters.
- `tool.slice` (reads): Chooses the Slice tool in the editor; use node.create to make a slice directly. No parameters.
- `tool.rectangle` (reads): Chooses the Rectangle tool in the editor; use shape.rectangle to draw one directly. No parameters.
- `tool.line` (reads): Chooses the Line tool in the editor; use shape.line to draw one directly. No parameters.
- `tool.arrow` (reads): Chooses the Arrow tool in the editor; use shape.arrow to draw one directly. No parameters.
- `tool.ellipse` (reads): Chooses the Ellipse tool in the editor; use shape.ellipse to draw one directly. No parameters.
- `tool.polygon` (reads): Chooses the Polygon tool in the editor; use shape.polygon to draw one directly. No parameters.
- `tool.star` (reads): Chooses the Star tool in the editor; use shape.star to draw one directly. No parameters.
- `tool.pen` (reads): Chooses the Pen tool in the editor; use vector.create to make a path directly. No parameters.
- `tool.pencil` (reads): Chooses the Pencil tool in the editor; use vector.create to make a path directly. No parameters.
- `tool.text` (reads): Chooses the Text tool in the editor; use text.create to add text directly. No parameters.
- `tool.comment` (reads): Chooses the Comment tool in the editor; use comment.add to add a comment directly. No parameters.
- `tool.shapeBuilder` (reads): Chooses the Shape builder tool in the editor; the design is unchanged. No parameters.
- `node.create` (writes): Creates a layer of a type (rectangle, ellipse, polygon, star, line, arrow, vector, text, frame, section, component, slice) at x, y in a parent with properties; answers its id.
  - `characters` string
  - `closed` boolean, vector points: a closed shape
  - `height` number
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0)
  - `name` string
  - `parent` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `path` string, SVG path data for vector
  - `points` array[], vector: instead of path
  - `props` object
  - `select` boolean
  - `text` string, for text
  - `type` string, one of `rectangle` | `ellipse` | `polygon` | `star` | `line` | `arrow` | `vector` | `text` | `frame` | `section` | `component` | `slice`
  - `width` number
  - `x` number
  - `y` number, relative to the parent frame; groups don't count
- `frame.create` (writes): Creates a frame from a device preset or a size, in a parent, with a name and properties; answers its id.
  - `height` number
  - `name` string
  - `parent` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `preset` string, name from FRAME_PRESETS
  - `props` object
  - `width` number
  - `x` number
  - `y` number
- `shape.rectangle` (writes): Draws a rectangle at x, y with width and height in a parent, with optional properties; answers its id.
  - `height` number
  - `parent` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `props` object
  - `width` number
  - `x` number
  - `y` number
- `shape.ellipse` (writes): Draws an ellipse in the box x, y, width, height in a parent, with optional properties; answers its id.
  - `height` number
  - `parent` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `props` object
  - `width` number
  - `x` number
  - `y` number
- `shape.polygon` (writes): Draws a polygon in a box with a point count in a parent; answers its id.
  - `height` number
  - `parent` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `width` number
  - `x` number
  - `y` number
- `shape.star` (writes): Draws a star in a box with a point count and inner radius in a parent; answers its id.
  - `height` number
  - `parent` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `width` number
  - `x` number
  - `y` number
- `shape.line` (writes): Draws a line of a length from x, y (optionally rotated) in a parent; answers its id.
  - `parent` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `width` number, length
  - `x` number
  - `y` number
- `shape.arrow` (writes): Draws an arrow of a length from x, y in a parent, with optional properties; answers its id.
  - `parent` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `props` object
  - `width` number, length
  - `x` number
  - `y` number
- `text.create` (writes): Creates a text layer at x, y in a parent with optional fixed width and text properties (font, size and more); answers its id.
  - `parent` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `props` object
  - `text` string
  - `width` number, fixed width wraps
  - `x` number
  - `y` number
- `vector.create` (writes): Creates a vector layer from SVG path data or points, open or closed, scaled to a box, in a parent; answers its id.
  - `closed` boolean
  - `height` number, scale the path; one keeps its proportion
  - `parent` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `path` string
  - `props` object
  - `width` number
  - `x` number
  - `y` number
- `image.place` (writes): Places an image from base64 or a path as a new image layer, or adds it as a fill on an existing layer.
  - `data` string
  - `height` number
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0); with `target`: fill `index` becomes the image in place, keeping its opacity, blend and visibility and, when it is an image already, its scale mode, tile scale, rotation and adjustments
  - `mode` string, one of `fill` | `fit` | `crop` | `tile`
  - `name` string, the image's name
  - `parent` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `target` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `width` number
  - `x` number
  - `y` number
- `frame.swapOrientation` (writes): Swaps the width and height of the selected or given frames (portrait and landscape).
  - `ids` array
- `frame.presets` (reads): Answers the device and paper frame presets with their sizes, for frame.create. No parameters.
- `edit.pasteDesignLayers` (writes): Pastes layers copied from another design app (clipboard HTML or design data) into a parent at x, y.
  - `data` string
  - `html` string
  - `parent` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `x` number
  - `y` number
- `select.set` (reads): Replaces the selection with the layers ids.
  - `ids` json[], [..]
- `select.add` (reads): Adds the layers ids to the selection.
  - `ids` array
- `select.remove` (reads): Removes the layers ids from the selection.
  - `ids` array
- `select.layersAt` (reads): Answers every layer under a page point, front-most first, with its id, name, type and depth.
  - `x` number
  - `y` number, page coordinates
- `select.area` (reads): Selects the layers inside a marquee rectangle (adding or including nested layers as asked); answers the selection.
  - `add` boolean
  - `deep` boolean
  - `height` number, page units; a marquee from x, y
  - `width` number
  - `x` number
  - `y` number
- `select.byName` (reads): Selects the layers whose names match a query on the current page or every page.
  - `page` integer, default current; "all" for every page
  - `query` string
- `transform.nudge` (writes): Nudges the selection by dx, dy times the nudge amount (auto-layout children move one place in the flow instead).
  - `big` boolean
  - `dx` number
  - `dy` number
- `transform.nudgeSize` (writes): Grows or shrinks the selection by dw, dh times the nudge amount, top-left fixed.
  - `big` boolean
  - `dh` number
  - `dw` number
- `object.opacityKeys` (writes): Sets the selection's opacity from typed digits, as the number keys do (1 is 10%, 0 is 100%, two digits a percentage).
  - `digits` string
  - `ids` array
- `node.set` (writes): Sets properties of a layer: name, visibility, lock, opacity, blend, position, size, rotation, fills, strokes, effects, corner radius, constraints, auto layout and text fields.
  - `id` integer, The layer to change (default the selection).
  - `ids` integer[], The layers to change (default the selection).
  - `props` object, required, The properties to set: name, visible, locked, opacity (0-1), blend, x, y (relative to the parent frame; groups don't count), width, height, rotation (degrees), fills (paints or colours; gradients as {type: linearGradient|radialGradient|angularGradient|diamondGradient, stops: ["#hex", ...], from?, to?} too), fill (colour, or "none"/null: no fill), strokes, stroke (colour, or "none"/null: no stroke), strokeWeight, strokeAlign (inside|center|outside), strokeSides [t,r,b,l], strokeTopWeight / strokeRightWeight / strokeBottomWeight / strokeLeftWeight (one side; turns on individual strokes), strokeCap / startCap / endCap, strokeJoin, miterAngle (degrees: sharper joins bevel; or miterLimit as a ratio), dashes [..], widthProfile (preset uniform|wedge|taper|eye|rounded|pinch, [[t, scale], ...] or null), brush (preset id, {preset, spacing, sizeJitter, rotationJitter, scatter, seed} or null), cornerRadius (n or [tl,tr,br,bl]), cornerSmoothing (0-1), effects, clip, isMask, layout (null|horizontal|vertical|grid|{...}), gap, crossGap, padding (n or [t,r,b,l]), paddingTop/Right/Bottom/Left, mainAlign (min|center|max, or the auto gaps spaceBetween|spaceAround|spaceEvenly), crossAlign (min|center|max|baseline: first text baselines, horizontal layouts), contentAlign (wrapped lines: auto = packed where crossAlign says | spaceBetween), wrap (rows of a horizontal layout, columns of a vertical one), strokesIncluded (the frame's inside stroke takes up space), reverseZ (canvas stacking: true = first on top), columnGap / rowGap (aliases of gap / crossGap), gridColumns, gridRows, columnTracks / rowTracks ([120 | "1fr" | "auto" | {sizing, value}]), gridColumn / gridRow (0-based cell anchor, null = auto), gridColumnSpan, gridRowSpan, gridAlignH / gridAlignV (a grid child's alignment in its cell: min|center|max, auto/null = the frame's), sizingH / sizingV (fixed|hug|fill), absolute (ignore auto layout; with start/end: the paragraphs those chars touch), indentation (list nesting level 0-8, same range rule), listSpacing (px between list items, in place of paragraphSpacing), hangingPunctuation, hangingList (markers outside the box), leadingTrim (vertical trim: none|capHeight), maxLines, features ({tag: bool}, e.g. {"liga": false, "tnum": true}), fontVariations / variationSettings ({axis: number}, e.g. {"wght": 550, "wdth": 85};
