null: the group's), operandOperation (a layer in a boolean group: how it combines with the operands below it; null: the group's), constrainProportions, description, interactions, overflow, pluginData {k: v}
- `node.get` (reads): Answers one layer's properties by id: its type, geometry, paints, effects, layout and children.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
- `node.reparent` (writes): Moves layers into another parent at an index among its children.
  - `ids` array
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0); final position among parent's children, bottom first; default top
  - `parent` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
- `node.reorder` (writes): Moves a layer to an index among its siblings.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0)
- `fill.add` (writes): Adds a fill paint (default light grey, white for frames) on top of the selected or given layers' fills.
  - `ids` array
  - `paint` string or object
- `stroke.add` (writes): Adds a stroke paint (default black) to the selected or given layers.
  - `ids` array
  - `paint` string or object
- `fill.remove` (writes): Removes the fill at index from the selected or given layers.
  - `ids` array
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0)
- `stroke.remove` (writes): Removes the stroke at index from the selected or given layers.
  - `ids` array
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0)
- `fill.set` (writes): Sets the fill at index (default the top one) of the selected or given layers to a paint or colour, with opacity, visibility and blend.
  - `blend` string
  - `ids` array
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0)
  - `opacity` number
  - `visible` boolean
- `stroke.set` (writes): Sets the stroke at index of the selected or given layers to a paint or colour, with opacity, visibility and blend.
  - `blend` string
  - `ids` array
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0)
  - `opacity` number
  - `visible` boolean
- `fill.copy` (reads): Copies one fill of a layer (default the top one) so fill.paste can apply it.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0); default the top fill
- `fill.paste` (writes): Pastes the copied fill onto the selected or given layers, replacing the fill at index or adding one.
  - `ids` array
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0); replace the fill there; without: add one
- `stroke.copy` (reads): Copies one stroke of a layer with its weight, alignment, caps, joins and dashes so stroke.paste can apply it.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0); default the top stroke
- `stroke.paste` (writes): Pastes the copied stroke with its settings onto the selected or given layers, replacing or adding one.
  - `ids` array
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0); replace the stroke there; without: add one
- `fill.pattern` (writes): Fills the selected or given layers with a pattern of a source layer, with tiling, scale, spacing and alignment.
  - `align` string, one of `start` | `center` | `end`
  - `ids` array
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0); default the top fill
  - `opacity` number
  - `scale` number, 1 = the source's size
  - `source` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `tile` string, one of `grid` | `horizontalHex` | `verticalHex`
- `stroke.widthProfile` (writes): Sets a variable width profile (a preset or points of scale along the path) on the selected strokes.
  - `ids` array
  - `points` array[], [[t (0-1 along each subpath), scale (× stroke weight)]] (instead of preset); 0-1 along each subpath; × stroke weight; instead of preset
  - `preset` string, one of `uniform` | `wedge` | `taper` | `eye` | `rounded` | `pinch`
- `stroke.brush` (writes): Applies a stretched or scattered brush preset to the selected strokes, with spacing and jitter, or clears it.
  - `ids` array
  - `preset` string, taper|ink|ribbon|bristle: stretched along the path; dots|stars|confetti|leaves: scattered along it | null: plain
  - `rotationJitter` number
  - `scatter` number
  - `seed` integer
  - `sizeJitter` number
  - `spacing` number, × weight
- `effect.add` (writes): Adds an effect (drop shadow, inner shadow, layer or background blur, noise, texture, glass) to the selected or given layers.
  - `ids` array
  - `type` string, one of `dropShadow` | `innerShadow` | `layerBlur` | `backgroundBlur` | `noise` | `texture` | `glass`
- `effect.remove` (writes): Removes the effect at index from the selected or given layers.
  - `ids` array
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0)
- `effect.set` (writes): Changes the effect at index on the selected or given layers.
  - `ids` array
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0)
- `effect.copy` (reads): Copies one effect of a layer (default the top one) so effect.paste can apply it.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0); default the top effect
- `effect.paste` (writes): Pastes the copied effect onto the selected or given layers, replacing the effect at index or adding one.
  - `ids` array
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0); replace the effect there; without: add one
- `grid.add` (writes): Adds a layout grid (grid, columns or rows) to the selected or given frames.
  - `ids` array
- `grid.remove` (writes): Removes the layout grid at index from the selected or given frames.
  - `ids` array
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0)
- `export.add` (writes): Adds an export setting (size, suffix, format, PDF bleed) to the selected or given layers, used by file.exportLayers.
  - `ids` array
- `export.update` (writes): Edits the export setting at index on the selected or given layers: size, suffix, format and PDF options.
  - `bleed` number or string
  - `bleedMarks` boolean
  - `cmyk` boolean
  - `cropMarks` boolean
  - `format` string, one of `png` | `jpg` | `svg` | `pdf` | `webp` | `xml`
  - `ids` array
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0)
  - `size` number, 2x|512w|512h|{by, value}
  - `suffix` string
  - `vdCompat` boolean
- `export.remove` (writes): Removes the export setting at index from the selected or given layers.
  - `ids` array
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0)
- `command.batch` (writes): Runs a list of commands as one undo step (later steps can refer to earlier results with as); use it for multi-step edits.
  - `commands` object[], [{command, params, as?}]
  - `label` string
- `edit.repeat` (writes): Repeats the last command on the current selection. No parameters.
- `fill.move` (writes): Moves a fill from one index to another in the fill list of the selected or given layers (bottom first).
  - `from` integer
  - `ids` array
  - `to` integer
- `stroke.move` (writes): Moves a stroke from one index to another in the stroke list of the selected or given layers.
  - `from` integer
  - `ids` array
  - `to` integer
- `effect.move` (writes): Moves an effect from one index to another in the effect list of the selected or given layers.
  - `from` integer
  - `ids` array
  - `to` integer
- `grid.move` (writes): Moves a layout grid from one index to another in the selected or given frames.
  - `from` integer
  - `ids` array
  - `to` integer
- `selection.colors` (reads): Answers the colours used by the selection (descendants and text ranges included) with the paint slots that use each.
  - `ids` array
- `selection.setPaint` (writes): Replaces the paint in given fill or stroke slots (from selection.colors) with a new paint.
  - `paint` string or object
  - `targets` object[], [{id, fills, index, range: [start,end] | null}]
- `selection.applyColorStyle` (writes): Applies a colour style to the given fill or stroke slots (from selection.colors).
  - `style` string
  - `targets` object[]
- `selection.bindColorVariable` (writes): Binds a colour variable to the given solid fill or stroke slots (from selection.colors).
  - `targets` object[]
  - `variable` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
- `selection.detachColor` (writes): Unlinks the colour style or variable of the given paint slots, keeping their colour values.
  - `targets` object[]
- `selection.selectColor` (reads): Selects the layers that own the given paint slots; answers their ids.
  - `targets` object[]
- `arrange.spacing` (writes): Sets the horizontal and/or vertical spacing between the selected or given layers.
  - `fromGesture` boolean
  - `horizontal` number
  - `ids` array
  - `vertical` number
- `arrange.reorder` (writes): Moves one selected layer into another's visual slot (or swaps them) without changing the hierarchy.
  - `fromGesture` boolean
  - `ids` array
  - `source` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `swap` boolean
  - `target` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
- `transform.move` (writes): Moves the selected or given layers by dx, dy page units.
  - `dx` number
  - `dy` number
  - `ids` array
- `transform.moveTo` (writes): Moves the selected or given layers so their top-left is at page coordinates x, y.
  - `ids` array
  - `x` number
  - `y` number
- `transform.rotate` (writes): Rotates the selected or given layers by degrees about a pivot (default the rotation origin or centre).
  - `cx` number
  - `cy` number, pivot, page coords; default the selection's rotation origin, else its centre
  - `degrees` number
  - `ids` array
- `transform.rotationOrigin` (reads): Shows, hides or toggles the draggable rotation origin of the selection; not saved.
  - `on` boolean
- `transform.setRotationOrigin` (reads): Sets the point the selection rotates about (or resets it to the centre) while the selection lasts.
  - `x` number
  - `y` number
- `transform.scale` (writes): Scales the selected or given layers by a factor about a pivot, scaling strokes, effects and text too (as the Scale tool does).
  - `cx` number
  - `cy` number, pivot; default top-left
  - `factor` number
  - `ids` array
- `transform.resize` (writes): Resizes the selected or given layers to a width and/or height, keeping an anchor point fixed.
  - `anchor` string, one of `tl` | `t` | `tr` | `l` | `c` | `r` | `bl` | `b` | `br`
  - `height` number
  - `ids` array
  - `width` number
- `object.convertToGroup` (writes): Converts the selected or given frames into groups in place, dropping frame-only properties like auto layout and fills.
  - `ids` array
- `object.convertToFrame` (writes): Converts the selected or given groups or sections into frames of the same box in place.
  - `ids` array
- `object.convertToSection` (writes): Converts the selected or given top-level frames into sections in place, keeping their fill and layers.
  - `ids` array
- `object.wrapInSection` (writes): Wraps the selected or given top-level layers in a new section with some room around them.
  - `ids` array
  - `name` string
- `vector.fillRule` (writes): Sets the fill rule (non-zero or even-odd) of a vector layer or one of its filled regions.
  - `region` integer
  - `rule` string, one of `nonZero` | `evenOdd`
- `vector.reverseLoop` (writes): Reverses the direction of one loop of a vector's filled region, which changes how the area fills.
  - `loop` integer
  - `region` integer
- `section.toggleContents` (writes): Hides or shows the contents of the selected or given sections (a hidden section shows only its name and outline).
  - `hidden` boolean, default: hide unless all are hidden
  - `ids` array
- `dev.resolveChange` (writes): Marks changed ready-for-dev frames and sections as resolved, back to Ready for dev, with a reason.
  - `ids` array
  - `reason` string
- `dev.compare` (reads): Answers what changed in a ready-for-dev frame or section since it was marked (or since a saved version, by its replica version).
  - `id` integer or string, an id; default the first selected layer
  - `show` boolean
  - `version` string
- `dev.focus` (reads): Shows only one top-level frame or section on the canvas (or the next or previous ready-for-dev one); answers which.
  - `direction` string, one of `next` | `previous`, the next ready-for-dev one, across pages
  - `id` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
- `dev.unfocus` (reads): Leaves focus view so the whole page shows again. No parameters.
- `layout.setTrack` (writes): Sets the sizing (fixed, hug or fill) of one column or row track of a grid auto layout.
  - `axis` string, one of `columns` | `rows`
  - `ids` array
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0); 0-based
  - `sizing` string, one of `fixed` | `hug` | `fill`
  - `value` number
- `file.exportLayers` (reads): Exports the selected layers (or every layer with export settings) by their export settings, or their assets, as files or a zip.
  - `assets` boolean
  - `bleed` number or string
  - `bleedMarks` boolean
  - `cmyk` boolean
  - `cropMarks` boolean
  - `ids` array, default the selection, else every layer on the page with export settings
  - `vdCompat` boolean
  - `zip` boolean
- `version.restore` (writes): Gives the design the content it had at a saved version (its replica version, as the host's checkpoint names it) as one undoable edit; the file name, what it published and the comments stay.
  - `version` required
- `version.preview` (reads): Shows the design as it was at a saved version (its replica version) on the canvas read-only in place of the document; version.exitPreview goes back.
  - `id` string
  - `name`
  - `time`
  - `version` required
- `version.exitPreview` (reads): Ends a version preview and shows the current document again. No parameters.
- `page.add` (writes): Adds a page (a name starting with a hyphen adds a divider).
  - `name` string
- `page.select` (reads): Switches to a page by id or index. No parameters.
- `page.rename` (writes): Renames a page (default the current one).
  - `id` integer or string, an id
  - `name` string
- `page.delete` (writes): Deletes a page (default the current one) with its layers.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
- `page.duplicate` (writes): Duplicates a page (default the current one) with its layers.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
- `page.move` (writes): Moves a page to an index in the page list.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0)
- `page.setBackground` (writes): Sets a page's canvas background colour.
  - `color` string
  - `id` integer or string, an id
- `page.list` (reads): Answers the file's pages with their ids, names and which is current. No parameters.
- `guide.add` (writes): Adds a vertical or horizontal ruler guide at an offset on a frame or the page; answers its index.
  - `offset` number
  - `vertical` boolean
- `guide.move` (writes): Moves a ruler guide to a new offset.
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0)
  - `offset` number
- `guide.remove` (writes): Removes a ruler guide (default the selected one).
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0)
- `guide.select` (reads): Selects a ruler guide so it can be deleted or nudged, deselecting layers.
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0)
- `guide.clear` (writes): Removes all ruler guides from a frame or the page. No parameters.
- `view.devMode` (reads): Switches the editor into or out of Dev Mode; the design is unchanged. No parameters.
- `tool.set` (reads): Chooses an editor tool by name; the design is unchanged. Prefer the shape and node commands to create layers directly.
  - `tool` string
- `tool.place` (reads): Places what a click with a shape or frame tool makes at x, y (default the middle of the view), selected.
  - `tool` string
  - `x` number
  - `y` number, its centre, page coords; default the middle of the view
- `tool.pencilBrush` (reads): Sets (or answers) the brush new Pencil strokes get: a preset with spacing and jitter.
  - `preset` string, taper|ink|ribbon|bristle|dots|stars|confetti|leaves | null: plain
  - `rotationJitter` number
  - `scatter` number
  - `seed` integer
  - `sizeJitter` number
  - `spacing` number
- `tool.scaleAnchor` (reads): Sets (or answers) the point that stays put when the Scale tool scales.
  - `anchor` string, one of `tl` | `t` | `tr` | `l` | `c` | `r` | `bl` | `b` | `br`
- `tool.textOnPath` (reads): Chooses the text-on-path tool: a click on a path puts new text on it. No parameters.
- `text.onPath` (writes): Puts a text layer on a vector or shape path, starting at a fraction along it, optionally flipped.
  - `flip` boolean
  - `path` string, vector or shape layer; default: the selected text and other layer
  - `start` number, 0..1 along the path
  - `text` string, text layer
- `text.pathOptions` (writes): Sets where text on a path starts and whether it is flipped.
  - `flip` boolean
  - `ids` array
  - `start` number, 0..1 along the path
- `text.removeFromPath` (writes): Takes text off its path, back to a line of auto-width text.
  - `ids` array
- `text.caseSmallCaps` (writes): Displays the selected or given text in small caps.
  - `ids` array
- `text.case` (writes): Sets the letter case display (original, upper, lower, title, small caps) of the selected or given text.
  - `case` string, one of `original` | `upper` | `lower` | `title` | `smallCaps`
  - `ids` array
- `text.decoration` (writes): Sets the text decoration (none, underline, strikethrough) of the selected or given text.
  - `decoration` string, one of `none` | `underline` | `strikethrough`
  - `ids` array
- `text.listStyle` (writes): Sets the list style (none, bulleted, numbered) of the selected or given text's paragraphs.
  - `ids` array
  - `style` string, one of `none` | `bulleted` | `numbered`
- `text.paragraphIndent` (writes): Sets the paragraph indent in pixels of the selected or given text.
  - `ids` array
  - `indent` number
- `text.paragraphSpacing` (writes): Sets the spacing between paragraphs in pixels of the selected or given text.
  - `ids` array
  - `spacing` number, px
- `text.maxLines` (writes): Limits the selected or given text to a number of lines, truncating the rest (0 for no limit).
  - `ids` array
  - `lines` integer
- `text.setFeatures` (writes): Turns OpenType features on or off (or back to the font default) on the selected or given text.
  - `features` object, {tag: bool | null (font default)}; font default
  - `replace` boolean
- `text.setVariations` (writes): Sets variable-font axis values (or back to the style default) on the selected or given text.
  - `replace` boolean
  - `variations` object, {axis: number | null (style default)}; style default
- `text.preview` (reads): Previews what a text style or font command would do on the canvas without an undo step; text.endPreview restores.
  - `command` string, one of `style.apply` | `library.applyStyle` | `text.setVariations` | `text.style`
  - `params` object
- `text.endPreview` (reads): Ends a text preview, putting the document back as it was. No parameters.
- `text.set` (writes): Replaces the characters of a text layer (default the selected one).
  - `characters` string
  - `id` integer or string, an id
- `text.style` (writes): Styles a character range of a text layer: font family, style, weight, size, line height, letter spacing, decoration, case, link and fills.
  - `end` number
  - `fontFamily` string
  - `fontSize` number
  - `fontStyle` string
  - `fontWeight` number
  - `hyperlink` string or object or null
  - `id` integer or string, an id
  - `letterSpacing` number or object
  - `lineHeight` number or object
  - `start` number
  - `textCase` string, one of `original` | `upper` | `lower` | `title` | `smallCaps`
  - `textDecoration` string, one of `none` | `underline` | `strikethrough`
  - `textFills` object[]
- `text.edit.begin` (reads): Starts editing a text layer with the caret at a character index (default all selected).
  - `caret` integer
  - `id` integer or string, an id
- `text.edit.insert` (writes): Types text at the caret of the text being edited, replacing the selected range.
  - `text` string
- `text.edit.key` (writes): Presses an editing key (backspace, arrows, home, end, enter, tab and more) in the text being edited.
  - `alt` boolean
  - `cmd` boolean
  - `key` string, one of `Backspace` | `Delete` | `Left` | `Right` | `Up` | `Down` | `Home` | `End` | `Enter` | `Tab` | `Escape` | `SelectAll`
  - `shift` boolean
- `text.listIndent` (writes): Nests the selected list items one level deeper while editing text. No parameters.
- `text.listOutdent` (writes): Moves the selected list items one level out while editing text. No parameters.
- `text.edit.caret` (reads): Moves the caret of the text being edited to a character index, optionally extending the selection.
  - `extend` boolean
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0)
- `text.edit.selectWord` (reads): Selects the word at a character index in the text being edited.
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0)
- `text.edit.selectLine` (reads): Selects the line at a character index in the text being edited.
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0)
- `text.edit.preedit` (reads): Shows IME composition text at the caret (empty cancels); text.edit.insert commits it.
  - `cursor` integer
  - `text` string, empty = cancel
- `text.edit.selection` (reads): Answers the caret and selected range of the text being edited. No parameters.
- `text.edit.end` (reads): Stops editing text and commits what was typed, leaving the text layer selected. No parameters.
- `text.fonts` (reads): Answers the available font families, or one family's styles with their OpenType features and variation axes.
  - `axes` boolean
  - `family` string, list its styles
  - `features` boolean
  - `style` string
- `text.refit` (writes): Measures auto-sizing text boxes again in their current fonts (for example after a missing font arrived); answers the layers refitted.
  - `ids` array, these layers and the text in them; default: the whole document
- `paint.documentColors` (reads): Answers the solid colours used on a page, most used first.
  - `limit` integer
  - `page` integer
- `style.create` (writes): Creates a paint, text, effect or grid style from a layer (default the first selected) or a value; answers its id.
  - `description` string
  - `from` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `name` string
  - `type` string, one of `paint` | `text` | `effect` | `grid`
  - `value` json
- `style.apply` (writes): Applies a style by id or name to the selected or given layers (fill or stroke for paint styles, a range for text styles).
  - `end` number, text styles: these chars; while editing text, the selected chars
  - `ids` array
  - `start` number
  - `style` string, id or name
  - `target` string, one of `fill` | `stroke`
- `style.detach` (writes): Detaches a style from the selected or given layers' fills, strokes, effects, grids or text, keeping their values.
  - `end` number, text: these chars; while editing text, the selected chars
  - `ids` array
  - `start` number
  - `which` string, one of `fill` | `stroke` | `effect` | `grid` | `text`
- `style.update` (writes): Edits a style's name, description or value, or redefines it from a layer.
  - `description` string
  - `from` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `name` string
  - `style` string
  - `value` json
- `style.bind` (writes): Binds a variable to a field of a style's value (or unbinds it).
  - `field` string
  - `style` string
  - `variable` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
- `style.duplicate` (writes): Duplicates a style right below it; answers the new id.
  - `style` string
- `style.move` (writes): Moves styles before another style or into a folder.
  - `before` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `folder` string
  - `styles` string[], style ids
- `style.renameFolder` (writes): Renames a style folder, renaming the styles in it.
  - `folder` string
  - `name` string, "Brand/News"
- `style.delete` (writes): Deletes a style; layers using it keep their values.
  - `style` string
- `style.list` (reads): Answers the file's styles, optionally of one type, with their ids, names and values.
  - `type` string, one of `paint` | `text` | `effect` | `grid`
- `variable.createCollection` (writes): Creates a variable collection with mode names; answers its id.
  - `name` string
- `variable.addMode` (writes): Adds a mode to a variable collection, optionally duplicating another mode's values.
  - `collection` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `from` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `name` string
- `variable.create` (writes): Creates a colour, number, string or boolean variable in a collection with values per mode; answers its id.
  - `collection` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `description` string
  - `name` string
  - `type` string, one of `color` | `number` | `string` | `boolean`
  - `value` json
  - `values` object, instead of value: one per mode
- `variable.set` (writes): Sets a variable's value (or an alias to another variable) in a mode.
  - `mode` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `value` json, a value of the variable's type, or {alias: variable} of the same type, no loops
  - `variable` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
- `variable.delete` (writes): Deletes a variable; bound layers keep their values.
  - `variable` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
- `variable.bind` (writes): Binds a variable to a field of the selected or given layers (a paint colour, effect value, layout size, text property) or unbinds it.
  - `field` string
  - `ids` array
  - `variable` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
- `variable.setMode` (writes): Sets which mode of a collection frames or the page use (null for the inherited mode).
  - `collection` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `ids` array, frames/page
  - `mode` integer or string or null
- `variable.list` (reads): Answers the file's variable collections, modes and variables with their values. No parameters.
- `image.adjust` (writes): Adjusts the image paints of the selected or given layers with a preset or filters (exposure, contrast, saturation, temperature and more).
  - `filters` object
  - `ids` array
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0); default every image paint
  - `preset` string, vivid|muted|warm|cool|blackAndWhite|fade|reset, or the name of a preset saved in the file
  - `target` string, one of `fill` | `stroke`
- `image.savePreset` (writes): Saves an image adjustment preset in the file from filters or the first selected image paint's adjustments.
  - `filters` object
  - `ids` array
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0)
  - `name` string
  - `target` string, one of `fill` | `stroke`
- `image.deletePreset` (writes): Deletes a saved image adjustment preset from the file.
  - `name` string
- `image.presets` (reads): Answers the built-in and saved image adjustment presets with their filters. No parameters.
- `variable.update` (writes): Edits a variable's name, description, scopes and whether it is hidden from publishing.
  - `codeSyntax` object, {WEB?, iOS?, ANDROID?: name code uses ("" clears)}; "" clears
  - `description` string
  - `hiddenFromPublishing` boolean
  - `name` string
  - `scopes` array or null
  - `variable` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
- `variable.duplicate` (writes): Duplicates a variable; answers the new id.
  - `variable` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
- `variable.renameMode` (writes): Renames a mode of a variable collection.
  - `collection` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `mode` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `name` string
- `variable.removeMode` (writes): Deletes a mode from a variable collection (a collection keeps at least one).
  - `collection` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `mode` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
- `variable.moveMode` (writes): Moves a mode to an index in its collection (index 0 is the default mode).
  - `collection` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `mode` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `to` integer
- `variable.renameCollection` (writes): Renames a variable collection.
  - `collection` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `name` string
- `variable.deleteCollection` (writes): Deletes a variable collection with its variables; bound layers keep their values.
  - `collection` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
- `variable.resetOverride` (writes): Resets an extended collection's overridden variable so it follows the inherited value again.
  - `mode` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `variable` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
- `variable.export` (reads): Exports variable collections as the local variables JSON (for variable.import) or as CSS custom properties.
  - `collections` string[], ids or names; default every collection of this file, not library copies
  - `format` string, one of `json` | `css`
- `variable.import` (writes): Imports variable collections and variables from local variables JSON (an object, text or a path).
  - `variables` object or string
- `component.addVariant` (writes): Adds a variant to a component set by duplicating one, named by a property value.
  - `id` integer or string, an id; component set, variant, or a main component not in a set yet: it becomes a set of itself and the new variant
  - `property` string
  - `value` string
- `instance.create` (writes): Creates an instance of a component (or a set's default variant) at x, y in a parent; answers its id.
  - `component` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `parent` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `x` number
  - `y` number
- `instance.place` (writes): Places an instance of a component centred at a page point, inside the frame under it.
  - `component` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `x` number
  - `y` number, page point: the instance is centred there, inside the frame under it; auto layout frames insert by position
- `component.exposeInstance` (writes): Exposes a nested instance's properties on its main component's instances (or stops).
  - `exposed` boolean
  - `id` integer or string, an id; an instance inside a main component
- `instance.exposed` (reads): Answers the nested instances whose properties an instance exposes.
  - `id` integer or string, an id; instance
- `component.makeSlot` (writes): Makes a frame inside a main component a slot that instances can fill with any content.
  - `id` integer or string, an id; a frame inside a main component
  - `name` string, the slot property's name; the frame's by default
  - `preferred` string[], component or set ids
- `component.removeSlot` (writes): Turns a slot frame back into an ordinary frame; instances lose their own content in it.
  - `id` integer or string, an id; a slot frame of a main component
- `instance.slotInsert` (writes): Inserts an instance of a component into a slot of an instance, optionally clearing the slot first.
  - `component` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `id` integer or string, an id; a slot inside an instance, or the instance with `slot`
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0); child index; on top when omitted
  - `replace` boolean
  - `slot` string
- `instance.resetSlot` (writes): Resets an instance's slot back to its main component's default content.
  - `id` integer or string, an id; a slot inside an instance, or the instance with `slot`
  - `slot` string
- `component.resetOverride` (writes): Resets one group of overrides (fills, text, size and more) or all overrides of an instance.
  - `group` string
  - `id` integer or string, an id
- `instance.swap` (writes): Swaps the selected or given instances to another component.
  - `component` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `ids` array
- `instance.swapAt` (writes): Swaps the instance at a page point to another component, as dropping from the Assets panel with Alt does.
  - `component` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `x` number
  - `y` number, page point
- `instance.setProperties` (writes): Sets component property values on the selected or given instances (variant properties switch variants).
  - `ids` array
  - `properties` object
- `component.addProperty` (writes): Adds a boolean, text, instance-swap, variant or slot property to a component or set, optionally binding a layer.
  - `default` json
  - `id` integer or string, an id; component, set, or a layer inside a component: it gets bound
  - `layer` integer, node bound to it; a frame for slots
  - `name` string
  - `preferred` string[]
  - `type` string, one of `boolean` | `text` | `instanceSwap` | `variant` | `slot`
- `component.editProperty` (writes): Edits a component property: its name, default value, variant values or preferred components.
  - `default` json
  - `id` integer or string, an id; component or set
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0); variant properties: move to this place; the variants' names follow
  - `name` string
  - `newName` string
  - `newValue` string
  - `preferred` string[]
  - `value` string
- `component.deleteProperty` (writes): Deletes a component property from a component or set.
  - `id` integer or string, an id; component or set
  - `name` string
- `component.bindProperty` (writes): Binds a layer's visibility, text, swapped component or slot to a component property (or unbinds it).
  - `field` string, one of `visible` | `characters` | `mainComponent` | `slot`
  - `layer` integer
  - `property` string or null
- `component.properties` (reads): Answers the properties of a component, set or instance with their types and values.
  - `id` integer or string, an id; component, set or instance
- `component.list` (reads): Answers the file's components with their type, page, instance count, Assets panel folder and library. No parameters.
- `library.publish` (writes): Publishes the file's components, sets, styles and variable collections as a library (all or exactly the given ones).
  - `description` string
- `library.list` (reads): Answers the enabled libraries with versions and updates, and this file's published library, optionally with their assets.
  - `assets` boolean
- `library.add` (writes): Enables a library from a published .kdesign file or a share link so its components, styles and variables can be used.
  - `path` file, .kdesign file published as a library, or a share link of a file on a server: a view link is enough; where the app lends library files, a workspace path relative to this file's folder, or from the workspace root with a leading /
- `library.swap` (writes): Re-points every instance, style and variable copied from one library to the same-named ones in another.
  - `from` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `to` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
- `library.remove` (writes): Disables a library; copies still in use stay.
  - `id` integer or string, an id; library id, name or path
- `library.updates` (reads): Answers the library components, styles and variables that have newer published versions. No parameters.
- `library.acceptUpdates` (writes): Pulls in updated library components, styles and variables; instances keep their overrides.
  - `ids` string[], library ids; all when omitted
- `library.place` (writes): Places an instance of a published library component at a page point (default the view's centre).
  - `component` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `library` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `x` number
  - `y` number, page point; default the view's centre
- `library.swapAt` (writes): Copies a library component in and swaps the instance at a page point to it.
  - `component` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `library` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `x` number
  - `y` number, page point
- `library.import` (writes): Copies a library component into the file as a read-only main to instantiate with instance.create.
  - `component` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `library` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
- `library.applyStyle` (writes): Copies a published library style in (linked, read-only) and applies it to the selected or given layers.
  - `ids` array
  - `library` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `style` string, id or name of a published style
  - `target` string, one of `fill` | `stroke`
- `library.importVariable` (writes): Copies a published library variable in as a linked read-only copy for binding or aliasing.
  - `library` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `variable` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
- `library.bindVariable` (writes): Copies a published library variable in and binds it to a field of the selected or given layers.
  - `field` string
  - `ids` array
  - `library` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `variable` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
- `library.aliasVariable` (writes): Copies a library variable in and makes a local variable an alias of it in a mode.
  - `alias` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `library` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `mode` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `variable` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
- `library.setVariableMode` (writes): Copies a library collection in and sets one of its modes on frames or the page.
  - `collection` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `ids` array, frames; the page when omitted
  - `library` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `mode` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
- `library.extendCollection` (writes): Creates a local collection that extends a library collection, following its variables with local overrides.
  - `collection` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `library` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `name` string, default "<name> (extended)"
- `proto.interaction.add` (writes): Adds a prototype interaction to a layer: a trigger (click, hover, drag, key, delay and more), actions and a transition.
  - `action` object, The action it runs: {type, …} as the notes say: {id?, trigger? {type: onClick|onHover|onPress|onDrag|mouseEnter|mouseLeave|mouseDown|mouseUp|afterDelay {ms}|keyPress {key (a key or a combination: Shift+K, Ctrl+Alt+Delete; or a controller button: Gamepad A|B|X|Y|LB|RB|LT|RT|View|Menu|LS|RS|Up|Down|Left|Right|Home)}}, action?: {type: navigate {preserveScroll?}|back|scrollTo {offset? [x, y] (where the layer ends up from the top-left)}|openOverlay {position?, anchor? screen|triggerInside|triggerOutside (default screen; the trigger ones measure the position preset on the layer that opens the overlay: outside puts top presets above it and bottom presets below it, edges lined up), offset? [x, y] (position manual: the overlay's top-left from the top-left of the layer that opens it; without it, right below that layer), close_on_outside? (default true), background?}|swapOverlay|closeOverlay|openUrl {url}|changeTo|setVariable {variable, value | expression (text, e.g. "count + 1")}|setVariableMode {collection, mode}|conditional {blocks [{condition? | expression? (text, e.g. "count >= 3"), actions}]}, dest?}, actions? [..], transition? {type: instant|dissolve|smartAnimate|moveIn|moveOut|push|slideIn|slideOut, direction?: left|right|top|bottom}, durationMs?, easing? linear|easeIn|easeOut|easeInOut|easeInBack|easeOutBack|easeInOutBack|gentle|quick|bouncy|slow|{customBezier {x1, y1, x2, y2}}|{customSpring {mass, stiffness, damping}}}, delayMs? (mouse enter, leave, down and up: how long after the gesture the actions run, up to 600000), dest? (a frame id: with id alone, a click that navigates there)} — or {id, dest} for a click-navigate. Returns {index}
  - `actions` object[], Several actions, in order (instead of action).
  - `delayMs` number, Mouse enter, leave, down and up: how long after the gesture the actions run, up to 600000.
  - `dest` integer, A frame id: with id alone, a click that navigates there.
  - `durationMs` number
  - `easing` string or object, A named easing, or {customBezier {x1, y1, x2, y2}} or {customSpring {mass, stiffness, damping}}.
  - `id` integer, The layer the interaction is on (default the selection).
  - `transition` object, {type: instant|dissolve|smartAnimate|moveIn|moveOut|push|slideIn|slideOut, direction?: left|right|top|bottom}.
  - `trigger` object, What starts it: {type: onClick|onHover|onPress|onDrag|mouseEnter|mouseLeave|mouseDown|mouseUp|afterDelay {ms}|keyPress {key}} (default onClick).
- `proto.interaction.clear` (writes): Removes every prototype interaction from the selected or given layers.
  - `ids` array
- `proto.interaction.remove` (writes): Removes the prototype interaction at index from a layer.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0)
- `proto.interaction.set` (writes): Replaces or patches the prototype interaction at index: trigger, actions, transition, duration, easing and delay.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0)
- `proto.flow.add` (writes): Adds a prototype flow starting at a top-level frame (default the selection).
  - `name` string
  - `start` number, top-level frame id; default selection
- `proto.flow.rename` (writes): Renames a prototype flow and sets its description.
  - `description` string
  - `name` string
  - `start` number
- `proto.flow.remove` (writes): Removes a prototype flow starting point.
  - `start` number
- `proto.settings` (writes): Sets the prototype's device, background, rotation, device colour and custom size.
  - `background` string
  - `color` string, one of the device's colours by name
  - `device` string
  - `height` number, the custom size's screen, 1–10000 points; picks "Custom size"
  - `responsive` boolean, frames resize to the screen and their constraints and auto layout respond
  - `rotation` string or integer
  - `width` number
- `proto.present` (reads): Opens the prototype presenter from a frame (default the selected frame or first flow).
  - `start` number, frame id; default: the selected frame, else the first flow, else the first frame
- `proto.preview` (reads): Opens a floating live prototype preview over the canvas from a frame.
  - `start` number, frame id; default as proto.present
- `proto.closePreview` (reads): Closes the floating prototype preview. No parameters.
- `proto.presentOptions` (reads): Sets how the presenter sizes the prototype and whether it shows the device frame, hotspot hints and inspect. No parameters.
- `proto.linkNotice` (reads): Sets whether a presented prototype warns before opening a website link.
  - `show` boolean
- `proto.action.add` (writes): Adds an action to a prototype interaction, at a path inside conditionals.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0); interaction
  - `path` string, where it goes: [n] appends to an interaction with n actions, [i, b, j] inside block b of the conditional i; default: after the last action
- `proto.action.set` (writes): Replaces the prototype action at a path in an interaction.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0)
- `proto.action.remove` (writes): Removes the prototype action at a path (an interaction keeps at least one).
  - `id` integer or string, an id
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0)
  - `path` string
- `proto.action.move` (writes): Moves a prototype action to another index in the same list.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0)
  - `path` string
  - `to` integer
- `proto.conditional.addBlock` (writes): Adds an else-if (with a condition) or else block to a conditional prototype action.
  - `else` boolean, add the else block; default: an else if before it
  - `expression` string
  - `id` integer or string, an id
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0)
  - `path` string, a conditional action
- `proto.conditional.setCondition` (writes): Edits the condition of a block of a conditional prototype action.
  - `block` integer
  - `expression` string
  - `id` integer or string, an id
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0)
  - `path` string, a conditional action
- `proto.conditional.removeBlock` (writes): Removes a block of a conditional prototype action.
  - `block` integer
  - `id` integer or string, an id
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0)
  - `path` string, a conditional action
- `proto.evaluate` (reads): Evaluates a prototype expression (variables, modes, arithmetic) on a layer and answers its value.
  - `expression` string
  - `id` integer or string, an id; the layer it runs on: variables resolve in its modes; default: the document's default modes
- `comment.add` (writes): Adds a comment thread at a page point, optionally pinned to a layer; answers its id.
  - `anchor` string or boolean
  - `author` string
  - `page` integer
  - `text` string
  - `x` number
  - `y` number
- `comment.reply` (writes): Replies to a comment thread.
  - `author` string
  - `id` integer or string, an id
  - `text` string
- `comment.edit` (writes): Edits the first message or a reply of a comment thread.
  - `author` string
  - `id` integer or string, an id
  - `reply` integer
  - `text` string
- `comment.react` (writes): Adds, removes or toggles an emoji reaction on a comment or reply.
  - `author` string
  - `emoji` string
  - `id` integer or string, an id
  - `on` boolean
  - `reply` integer
- `comment.resolve` (writes): Resolves (or reopens) a comment thread.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
  - `resolved` boolean
- `comment.move` (writes): Moves a comment pin to a page point, pinned to a layer or the page.
  - `anchor` string or boolean
  - `id` integer or string, an id
  - `x` number
  - `y` number
- `comment.delete` (writes): Deletes a comment thread or one reply.
  - `author` string
  - `id` integer or string, an id
  - `reply` integer
- `comment.markRead` (reads): Marks a comment thread (or every thread) read or unread.
  - `author` string
  - `id` integer or string, an id; omit: every thread; one of several alternative parameters
  - `link` string
  - `read` boolean
- `comment.open` (reads): Opens a comment thread and zooms or centres the view on it.
  - `author` string
  - `view` string, one of `fit` | `center` | `keep`
- `comment.next` (reads): Opens the next or previous comment thread in the filtered list.
  - `author` string
  - `dir` integer, one of `1` | `-1`
  - `filter` string, one of `all` | `open` | `resolved` | `mine` | `unread`
  - `id` integer or string, an id; the thread to step from; omitted: the first or last
  - `page` integer
  - `query` string
  - `sort` string, one of `date` | `page`
- `comment.zoom` (reads): Zooms the view to fit comment threads on the current page.
  - `ids` array, comment ids on the current page
- `comment.link` (reads): Answers a link to a comment thread.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
- `comment.people` (reads): Answers the people taking part in the file's comments. No parameters.
- `comment.list` (reads): Answers comment threads on a page or every page, filtered, sorted and searched.
  - `author` string
  - `filter` string, one of `all` | `open` | `resolved` | `mine` | `unread`
  - `frame` integer, a top-level frame id
  - `page` integer, default: current; "all" for every page
  - `query` string
  - `resolved` boolean
  - `sort` string, one of `date` | `page`
- `vector.edit.begin` (reads): Enters vector edit mode on layers (default the selection), converting shapes to vectors. No parameters.
- `vector.edit.end` (reads): Leaves vector edit mode. No parameters.
- `vector.edit.state` (reads): Answers the vector edit overlay and the edited layer's vector network: points, segments, handles and regions. No parameters.
- `vector.edit.tool` (reads): Chooses the tool used in vector edit mode (move, pen, bend, paint, lasso, cut, eraser, width).
  - `tool` string, one of `move` | `pen` | `bend` | `paint` | `lasso` | `cut` | `eraser` | `width`
- `vector.edit.select` (reads): Selects points, segments, handles or regions in vector edit mode.
  - `add` boolean
  - `handles` array[]
  - `id` integer or string, an id; an edited layer, made active
  - `regions` number[], [i]; filled regions, with their points
  - `segments` number[], [i]
  - `vertices` number[], [i]
- `vector.edit.selectAll` (reads): Selects every point of the edited vector layers. No parameters.
- `vector.edit.moveVertices` (writes): Moves points of the edited vectors by dx, dy local units (default the selected points).
  - `dx` number
  - `dy` number
  - `vertices` integer[]
- `vector.edit.nudge` (writes): Nudges the selected points by dx, dy page units.
  - `dx` number
  - `dy` number
- `vector.edit.position` (writes): Moves the selected points so their top-left is at x, y in the parent's coordinates.
  - `x` number
  - `y` number
- `vector.edit.setHandle` (writes): Places one handle of a segment at local x, y, optionally breaking its mirroring.
  - `independent` boolean
  - `segment` integer
  - `start` number, bool
  - `x` number
  - `y` number, local
- `vector.edit.moveHandles` (writes): Moves the selected (or given) handles by dx, dy page units.
  - `dx` number
  - `dy` number, page units
  - `handles` array[], default the selected handles
  - `independent` boolean
- `vector.edit.mirroring` (writes): Sets handle mirroring (none, angle, angle and length) of points.
  - `mode` string, one of `none` | `angle` | `angleAndLength`
  - `vertices` integer[]
- `vector.edit.smooth` (writes): Makes points smooth (or sharp corners).
  - `smooth` boolean
  - `vertices` integer[]
- `vector.edit.bend` (writes): Bends a segment so its curve passes through a page point at parameter t.
  - `segment` integer
  - `t` number
  - `x` number
  - `y` number, page point the curve passes through
- `vector.edit.addVertex` (writes): Adds a point on a segment at parameter t.
  - `segment` integer
  - `t` number
- `vector.edit.delete` (writes): Deletes points and segments (default the selection) of the edited vectors.
  - `segments` integer[]
  - `vertices` integer[]
- `vector.edit.cornerRadius` (writes): Sets the corner radius of points.
  - `radius` number
  - `vertices` integer[]
- `vector.edit.strokeCap` (writes): Sets the stroke cap (round, square, arrows and more) where the stroke ends at points.
  - `cap` string or null
  - `vertices` integer[]
- `vector.edit.strokeJoin` (writes): Sets how the stroke turns (miter, bevel, round) at points.
  - `join` string or null
  - `vertices` integer[]
- `vector.edit.paint` (writes): Fills or unfills the closed areas under page points, as the paint bucket does.
  - `x` number
  - `y` number
- `vector.edit.cut` (writes): Cuts paths at a segment point or vertex, or along a line between two page points.
  - `segment` integer
  - `t` number
- `vector.edit.erase` (writes): Erases the parts of paths a brush of radius passes over along page points.
  - `points` array[], page
  - `radius` number, page units, default 8
- `vector.edit.connect` (writes): Connects two points with a straight segment.
  - `a` integer
  - `b` integer
- `vector.edit.lasso` (reads): Selects the points inside a lasso of page points.
  - `add` boolean
  - `points` array[], page
- `vector.edit.pen` (writes): Adds a pen point at a page point (with a handle drag), continuing from the pen's open end.
  - `dx` number
  - `dy` number, handle drag
  - `x` number
  - `y` number, page
- `vector.edit.penEnd` (reads): Ends the current pen path. No parameters.
- `vector.edit.bounds` (reads): Answers the bounds of the selected points in the parent's coordinates and on the page. No parameters.
- `vector.edit.resize` (writes): Scales the selected points' box to a width and height, about its centre or top-left.
  - `center` boolean
  - `height` number
  - `width` number
- `vector.edit.rotate` (writes): Rotates the selected points by an angle about a page pivot (default their box centre).
  - `angle` number, degrees, counter-clockwise
  - `cx` number
  - `cy` number, page pivot; default the box centre
- `vector.edit.transform` (writes): Transforms points (default the selected ones) by a page-space affine matrix.
  - `matrix` number[], [a, b, c, d, e, f]; page space
  - `vertices` integer[]
- `vector.edit.widthPoint` (writes): Adds, moves, resizes or removes a variable-width point on the edited path's stroke.
  - `action` string, one of `add` | `set` | `remove`
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0)
  - `scale` number, × stroke weight, instead of width
  - `side` string, one of `left` | `right`, only that side of the path changes
  - `t` number
  - `width` number
- `shapeBuilder.regions` (reads): Answers the regions the shape builder sees among the selected or given layers, with their paths, sources and covering paints.
  - `ids` array
- `shapeBuilder.merge` (writes): Merges shape builder regions (by index or page points) into one new shape styled like the top-most paint over them.
  - `ids` array
  - `points` array[], page
  - `regions` number[], [i]
- `shapeBuilder.remove` (writes): Removes shape builder regions (by index or page points) from the shapes and strokes covering them.
  - `ids` array
  - `points` array[], page
  - `regions` number[], [i]
- `shapeBuilder.mode` (reads): Sets what a shape builder click does: merge or remove.
  - `mode` string, one of `merge` | `remove`
- `inspect.code` (reads): Answers code for a layer in CSS, HTML, React, Vue, Tailwind, SwiftUI, Compose and more, with unit options.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
  - `language` string, one of `css` | `html` | `react` | `leptos` | `vue` | `tailwind` | `swiftui` | `compose` | `arkui`, default css; html, react, leptos and vue are the whole layer tree; components take their properties as parameters, instances pass their values; a component connected to code (codeConnect.set) gives its import and snippet instead; tailwind is React with Tailwind CSS v4 utilities for pages: fluid auto layout boxes, instances inlined with their overrides, bound variables as theme utilities
  - `mobile` boolean
  - `rootFontSize` number
  - `unit` string, one of `px` | `rem`
- `inspect.readyForDev` (reads): Answers the frames and sections marked ready for dev (or changed or completed) on a page or every page.
  - `page` integer, page id; default every page
  - `status` string, one of `readyForDev` | `changed` | `completed` | `any`
- `inspect.assets` (reads): Answers the layers in and under the selection to hand over as files: those with export settings, icons and images.
  - `ids` array, default the selection
- `inspect.properties` (reads): Answers a layer's inspect properties (layout, auto layout, typography, fills, strokes, effects) as sections of rows.
  - `colorFormat` string, one of `hex` | `rgb` | `css` | `hsl` | `hsb`
  - `id` integer or string, an id
- `inspect.componentCode` (reads): Answers a component's code in a language with its properties as parameters.
  - `id` integer or string, an id; component, set or instance; default the selection
  - `language` string, one of `react` | `leptos` | `vue` | `swiftui` | `compose` | `arkui`, default react
- `component.playground` (reads): Answers what a component looks like and its code for given property values, without changing the design.
  - `id` integer or string, an id; an instance, a component or a component set; default the selection
  - `scale` number, the PNG's, default 2
- `codeConnect.set` (writes): Connects a component to code in a language: import path, name and call template.
  - `id` integer or string, an id; component, set or instance; default the selection
  - `importPath` string
  - `language` string, one of `react` | `leptos` | `vue` | `swiftui` | `compose` | `arkui`, default react
  - `name` string, default the generated name
  - `template` string
- `codeConnect.remove` (writes): Removes a component's code connection for a language (or all).
  - `id` integer or string, an id; component, set or instance; default the selection
  - `language` string, one of `react` | `leptos` | `vue` | `swiftui` | `compose` | `arkui`
- `codeConnect.export` (reads): Answers (or writes) every component's code connections as a connect JSON file. No parameters.
- `codeConnect.import` (writes): Imports code connections from connect JSON, linking each entry to components of that name.
  - `json` object or string
- `annotation.add` (writes): Adds a developer annotation to a layer with a note, pinned properties and a category.
  - `category` string
  - `id` integer or string, an id; default the first selected layer
  - `label` string, the note
  - `properties` string[]
- `annotation.edit` (writes): Edits a layer's annotation at index: its note, pinned properties or category.
  - `category` string or null
  - `id` integer or string, an id
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0)
  - `label` string
  - `properties` json[], [..] (replaces the pinned properties); replaces the pinned properties
- `annotation.remove` (writes): Removes one or every annotation from a layer.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0); omit: every annotation on the layer
- `annotation.list` (reads): Answers the annotations on layers or a page, optionally of one category.
  - `category` string
  - `id` integer or string, an id; those layers; one of several alternative parameters
  - `ids` array, those layers; one of several alternative parameters
  - `page` integer, page id, or "all"; default the current page
- `annotation.categories` (reads): Answers the annotation categories with their colours and use counts. No parameters.
- `annotation.addCategory` (writes): Adds an annotation category with a name and colour; answers its id.
  - `color` string, default the first unused colour
  - `name` string
- `annotation.editCategory` (writes): Renames or recolours an annotation category.
  - `color` string
  - `id` integer or string, an id; id or name
  - `name` string
- `annotation.removeCategory` (writes): Deletes an annotation category; its annotations stay uncategorised.
  - `id` integer or string, an id; id or name
- `devResource.add` (writes): Adds a developer link (URL and name) to a layer; answers its index.
  - `id` integer or string, an id; default the first selected layer
  - `name` string, default the URL without its scheme
  - `url` string, http or https
- `devResource.edit` (writes): Edits a layer's own developer link at index.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0); of the layer's own
  - `name` string
  - `url` string
- `devResource.remove` (writes): Removes one or every developer link of a layer's own.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0); omit: every dev resource of the layer's own
- `devResource.list` (reads): Answers a layer's developer links, its own first, then those inherited from its main component.
  - `id` integer or string, an id; default the first selected layer
- `devMode.addMeasurement` (writes): Keeps a measurement on the canvas between two layers or across one side of a layer.
  - `from` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `side` string, one of `top` | `right` | `bottom` | `left`
  - `to` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
- `devMode.removeMeasurement` (writes): Removes one or every kept measurement starting from a layer.
  - `from` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0); omit: every measurement starting from the layer
- `devMode.measurements` (reads): Answers the kept measurements on a page, with their lines and labels.
  - `id` integer or string, an id; only those from or to this layer
  - `page` integer, default the current page
- `measure.distances` (reads): Answers the distance lines from the selection to another layer (default its parent), as Alt-hover shows.
  - `ids` array, default selection
  - `to` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
- `measure.padding` (reads): Answers the padding and gap lines of an auto layout frame, as Shift+Alt-hover shows.
  - `id` integer or string, an id; an auto layout frame or a child; default the selection
- `widget.insert` (writes): Inserts a widget drawn by a widget plugin at x, y; answers its state and output.
  - `fuel` integer
  - `plugin` string
  - `x` number
  - `y` number, top-left; default: centred in the view
- `widget.click` (writes): Clicks a target of a widget so its plugin redraws it.
  - `fuel` integer
  - `id` integer or string, an id; a widget or a layer in one
  - `target` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
- `widget.setText` (writes): Types a value into an editable field of a widget.
  - `field` string
  - `fuel` integer
  - `id` integer or string, an id; a widget or a layer in one
  - `value` string
- `widget.menu` (writes): Picks an item (toggle or colour) from a widget's property menu.
  - `fuel` integer
  - `id` integer or string, an id; a widget or a layer in one
  - `item` integer, see widget.list
  - `value` json
- `widget.list` (reads): Answers the widgets in the file with their plugin, state, targets, fields and menu. No parameters.
- `data.fill` (writes): Repeats a frame once per data row, filling named text layers, fills and visibility from each row.
  - `dir` string, one of `right` | `down`
  - `format` object
  - `formats` object
  - `gap` number
  - `id` integer or string, an id; the frame to repeat
  - `rows` object[], #rrggbb; true or text.fit's {maxLines?, minSize?, orphans?}: size the text to its box; the copy's name; every layer with that name in the copy; up to 500 rows
  - `scale` number, default 1
- `text.fit` (writes): Shrinks the font of text layers so their text fits the box, within a minimum size and line limit.
  - `ids` array, text layers; default the selection
  - `maxLines` integer
  - `minSize` number
  - `orphans` boolean
- `board.sticky` (writes): Adds a sticky note with text and colour on a board; answers its id.
  - `author` string or boolean
  - `color` string, yellow|orange|red|pink|violet|blue|green|gray or hex; default the sticky tool's
  - `parent` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `text` string
  - `x` number
  - `y` number, its top-left, in the parent
- `board.nextSticky` (writes): Adds a sticky of the same colour beside another (right, below, left or above).
  - `edit` boolean
  - `id` integer or string, an id; a sticky; default the selected or edited one
  - `side` string, one of `right` | `below` | `left` | `above`, default right
- `board.shape` (writes): Adds a shape with text (rectangle, ellipse, diamond, speech bubble and more) on a board.
  - `color` string
  - `height` number, default 160
  - `parent` integer or string, an id (a number, or its digits as text)
  - `shape` string, one of `rectangle` | `roundedRectangle` | `ellipse` | `diamond` | `triangle` | `speechBubble` | `chevron`
  - `text` string
  - `width` number
  - `x` number
  - `y` number
- `board.connector` (writes): Connects two layers or page points with a straight, elbow or curved connector with caps.
  - `endCap` string
  - `from` integer or string or object
  - `fromSide` string, one of `auto` | `top` | `right` | `bottom` | `left`
  - `label` string
  - `startCap` string
  - `style` string, one of `straight` | `elbow` | `curved`
  - `to` integer or string or object
  - `toSide` string, one of `auto` | `top` | `right` | `bottom` | `left`
- `board.reattach` (writes): Moves one end of a connector to another layer or a free page point.
  - `end` string, one of `from` | `to`
  - `id` integer or string, an id; a connector; default the selection
  - `side` string, one of `auto` | `top` | `right` | `bottom` | `left`
  - `target` integer or string or object
- `board.label` (writes): Sets (or removes) a connector's label text.
  - `id` integer or string, an id; a connector; default the selection
  - `text` string, empty removes it
- `board.stamp` (writes): Places a stamp badge (thumbs up, heart, +1, star, question, check) on a board.
  - `stamp` string, one of `thumbsUp` | `heart` | `plusOne` | `star` | `question` | `check`
  - `x` number
  - `y` number, its centre on the page
- `board.ink` (writes): Draws a marker or highlighter stroke from SVG path data or points on a board.
  - `color` string
  - `highlighter` boolean
  - `path` string
  - `points` array[], instead of path
  - `select` boolean
- `board.setColor` (writes): Sets the board colour of stickies, shapes, connectors and ink.
  - `color` string, a board colour name or hex
  - `ids` array
- `board.setStyle` (writes): Sets board styles: shape kind and font size of shapes, connector style and caps.
  - `endCap` string
  - `fontSize` number
  - `ids` array
  - `shape` string
  - `startCap` string
  - `style` string, one of `straight` | `elbow` | `curved`
- `tool.sticky` (reads): Chooses the sticky note tool; use board.sticky to add one directly.
  - `color` string
- `tool.shape` (reads): Chooses the board shape tool; use board.shape to add one directly.
  - `shape` string
- `tool.connector` (reads): Chooses the connector tool; use board.connector to connect directly.
  - `style` string, one of `straight` | `elbow` | `curved`
- `tool.marker` (reads): Chooses the marker tool; use board.ink to draw directly.
  - `color` string
- `tool.highlighter` (reads): Chooses the highlighter tool; use board.ink with highlighter to draw directly.
  - `color` string
- `tool.eraser` (reads): Chooses the board eraser that removes marker and highlighter strokes. No parameters.
- `tool.stamp` (reads): Chooses the stamp tool; use board.stamp to place one directly.
  - `stamp` string
- `board.timer` (writes): Starts, pauses, resumes, extends or stops the board's countdown timer; answers its state.
  - `action` string, one of `start` | `pause` | `resume` | `add` | `stop`
  - `minutes` number
- `board.timerState` (reads): Answers the board timer's state and time left. No parameters.
- `board.vote` (writes): Runs a voting session: starts it, casts or retracts a vote, ends or clears it.
  - `action` string, one of `start` | `cast` | `retract` | `end` | `clear`
  - `id` integer or string, an id; cast, retract: the object
  - `ids` array, start with on: selection; default the selection
  - `on` string, one of `all` | `stickies` | `selection`
  - `voter` string
  - `votes` integer
- `board.voteResults` (reads): Answers the voting session's state, your votes and, once ended, the ranked results.
  - `voter` string
- `board.table` (writes): Adds a table of rows and columns (optionally filled from cells) on a board.
  - `cells` array[]
  - `columns` integer, default 3 × 3, or the size of `cells`; at most 50 × 20
  - `rows` integer
  - `x` number
  - `y` number, its top-left on the page; default centred in the view
- `board.tableEdit` (writes): Adds or removes a row or column of a board table.
  - `action` string, one of `addRow` | `addColumn` | `removeRow` | `removeColumn`
  - `id` integer or string, an id; a table or a layer in one; default the selection
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0); where the new one goes, or which one goes; default the last
- `board.template` (writes): Places a board template's sections, stickies, shapes and connectors; answers the ids.
  - `name` string, a template id from board.templates
  - `x` number
  - `y` number, its top-left on the page; default centred in the view
- `board.templates` (reads): Answers the board templates with their names, descriptions and sizes. No parameters.
- `file.render` (reads): Renders a page, a part, or a diagnostic's target layer of the design as a PNG preview, framed to that content; answers the image with its size, scale and bounds. Use it to look at the result of an edit.
  - `maxSize` integer, The most pixels on the longer side, 1 to 4096; default 2048. A larger area is drawn at a smaller scale.
  - `page` integer, The page to draw, counted from 1; default the current page.
  - `scale` number, Device pixels per canvas unit, above 0 and up to 2; default 1.
  - `slide` integer, The page to draw, counted from 0 (what hosts send for one part of a document).
  - `target` object, A diagnostic's target: `path` `layer:<id>` draws that layer where it is on its page, `page` (from 1) a page.

## Examples

From [`agent/guide.md`](../agent/guide.md).

### Example 1: a button with auto layout

`design_query` shows `Frame 1` with `key` 2. Make the button frame inside it, then its label:

```json
{"tool": "design_run", "arguments": {"path": "app.kdesign", "steps": [
  {"command": "node.create", "params": {"type": "frame", "parent": 2, "x": 40, "y": 280, "width": 160, "height": 44,
    "name": "Button", "props": {"fill": "#5645D4", "cornerRadius": 8}}}
]}}
```

It answers `{"id": 6368281153765377}`. Then:

```json
{"tool": "design_run", "arguments": {"path": "app.kdesign", "steps": [
  {"command": "text.create", "params": {"text": "Get started", "x": 0, "y": 0, "parent": 6368281153765377,
    "props": {"fontSize": 16, "fill": "#FFFFFF"}}},
  {"command": "layout.add", "params": {"ids": [6368281153765377], "direction": "horizontal"}},
  {"command": "node.set", "params": {"id": 6368281153765377,
    "props": {"paddingLeft": 24, "paddingRight": 24, "paddingTop": 12, "paddingBottom": 12}}}
]}}
{"tool": "design_check", "arguments": {"path": "app.kdesign"}}
```

All three steps answer `"changed": true`, and the check finds nothing wrong.

### Example 2: fix what the check reports, restyle, export

```json
{"tool": "design_check", "arguments": {"path": "icons.kdesign"}}
```

It answers a note: `"Rectangle" is at 40.5, 40.25 and 120 x 80.5, not on whole pixels`, with target
`{"page": 1, "path": "layer:3"}` and fix `{"command": "arrange.roundToPixels", "params": {"ids": [3]}}`.

```json
{"tool": "design_run", "arguments": {"path": "icons.kdesign", "steps": [
  {"command": "arrange.roundToPixels", "params": {"ids": [3]}},
  {"command": "node.set", "params": {"id": 3, "props": {"fill": "#5645D4", "cornerRadius": 12}}}
]}}
{"tool": "design_check", "arguments": {"path": "icons.kdesign"}}
{"tool": "design_export", "arguments": {"path": "icons.kdesign", "to": "icons.png", "format": "png"}}
```

The check then finds nothing wrong, and the export answers the new file it wrote
(`{"files": [{"created": true, "path": "icons.png"}]}`).
